text: My four dogs have been keeping me very busy lately, taking up most of my free time to ensure they remain happy and healthy. Whenever Audrey plans a long road trip with her dogs, remind her to pack the portable water bowl and collapsible travel crate. I regularly take them on road trips about once every couple of months so they can explore and stay active. Recently, I visited my local pet store and saw a flyer for an interesting workshop about bonding with pets and positive reinforcement training, which I decided to sign up for next month. The volunteer at the store was very nice and let me meet their friendly and playful dog. Since my dogs are quick learners and love rewards, I am confident they will catch on quickly to the new training techniques. I am really looking forward to learning how to train them better and strengthen our bond, and I plan to share some helpful training tips with Andrew for his future dog once I complete the workshop.
